voice: Low, dry, economical; Lahori Punjabi with a Kasur accent, functional Urdu; breath gets shorter as the disease progresses

metahuman.note: MetaHuman Creator 5.8 body: use the Parametric Body tool, set the constraint targets listed below (cm; the tool shows the real constraint list for the model, use the ones it offers), then blend presets only to taste. Face: blend 2-3 South Asian presets then Sculpt/Move to the notes. Hair/beard from the Groom library.
metahuman.face_notes: Long face, strong nose with a slight bend (broken once), deep-set tired eyes, thick eyebrows, small scar through the left eyebrow, prominent cheekbones; Act 2/6 variants hollow the cheeks and temples

skin.description: Medium wheatish Punjabi; sun-weathered forearms and neck; pallor rises with disease
skin.note: U/V are starting values for the Creator skin-tone picker; judge by eye under neutral light and adjust

metahuman.eyes: Dark brown, slightly bloodshot at A2/A6

groom.beard: Stubble, medium; Act 2 long unkempt; Act 4 short full

fallback_mannequin.note: Applied automatically by UBodyStateComponent when the mesh has no morph targets

outfits.summer: Half-sleeve checked shirt over a white vest; dark jeans; leather sandals
outfits.monsoon: Quick-dry polyester shirt; dark trousers; rubber chappals
outfits.winter: Cheap black faux-leather jacket over a sweatshirt; jeans; canvas sports shoes; wool muffler
outfits.by_act: A1=above (collection-run gangster: gold-plated chain removed); A2=faded kurta and loose pyjama in rags or one donated blanket and a plastic sheet in rain; A3=plain cotton shirt and trousers then tracksuit; A4=muted shalwar kameez and waistcoat (Karachi) with a topi only for Friday prayers in the legend; A5=the same kurta hanging loose and sweat-stained; A6=oversized hooded sweatshirt and cardigan that no longer fit

accessories: Steel kada on the right wrist; a steel katora (begging bowl) and cloth bag in Act 2; cheap digital watch; no phone from Act 2
tells: Cracks his LEFT thumb when he lies (UCastTellComponent 'ThumbCrack'); counts everything under his breath (rupees, steps, chapatis); says little
gait_notes: Act 1: loose confident stride, slight forward lean, hands in pockets. Act 2: shortened stride, rounded shoulders, avoids eye contact, rests on one hip while standing. Act 4: deliberate neutral Karachi walk that he consciously holds. Act 5-6: hunched 9 degrees, slow, hand pressed to ribs, rests after stairs; a cough fit bends him double (input lock 2-4 s).
sensitivity: Born in Mamdot; grandparents from Kasur. Faith practice is kept low-key and respectful: kada, no caricature; the disease is shown as a body, not a spectacle.

body_states.acts: Act 1 (2019); Act 4 Phase 1 reads a few kg lighter
body_states.notes: Fed, wiry and quick; gangster swagger; clean clothes with flashy details
Minus 14 kg: visible ribs under the kurta, hollow cheeks, sun-darkened neck and forearms, filthy nails, matted hair
Minus 29 kg: TB wasting: temporal hollows, prominent clavicles, night-sweat sheen, pallor, loose clothes, dull eyes

weight_model: weight = Act1 weight + act delta - disease loss; Act 6 full disease: 78 - 4 - 25 = 49 kg (minus 29)
